recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13280 unless the work group wants a future optional editorial pass to replace generic example values with more realistic names.
issue_request: FHIR-13280 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core search issue asking for an example of a complex POST-based search, especially one with multiple parameters and URL-encoded characters such as a form body containing _id=123&family=Da%20Silva.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12863. In the Git mirror, commit 2cf07ef87a042eba6604231ebf868d8c1d536566 (#13280 - search post example improved) corresponds to that revision and added a POST [base]/[type]/_search example with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded and form parameters to source/http.html.
additional_context: The current HTTP page has an active HTTP POST search section showing server-root, resource-type, compartment, and compartment/resource POST _search examples with application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies. The current search page has paired GET/POST examples, including URL-encoding guidance and complex Patient searches using multiple parameters, repeated parameters, OR values, and modifiers. Bounded Jira search surfaced FHIR-33220 and FHIR-31588 as related background only; Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because adding a literal Da Silva example would duplicate current guidance rather than correct an implementer-facing gap.
